notes: Charter, pricing, and port details come from general knowledge, not the evidence.

vessel_marine_service.value: Dry-bulk shipping; seaborne transportation of commodities with full-service logistics

fleet_carrying_capacity.value: Sizeable wholly owned fleet of Newcastlemax, Capesize, Ultramax and Supramax dry cargo vessels
